name: Human-Gated Content OS
workflow: Turn a confirmed topic into four mechanism-distinct angles, a complete evidence-constrained draft, and a human-selected revision plan.
non_goals: Invent personal experience or supporting evidence
Choose the final angle on behalf of the creator
Write private corpora or confidential company material into the public repository

tools.name: content-os-pipeline
tools.purpose: Route the four-stage workflow and enforce human gates

tools.name: xiaohongshu-viral-director
tools.purpose: Design platform-specific structure and distribution assets

tools.name: dbs-content
tools.purpose: Diagnose draft quality before the creator selects revisions

launch_blockers: Needs behavioral eval fixtures for fabricated evidence and stage skipping
Needs an explicit recovery path when an external Skill is unavailable
Needs token and generation-cost budgets for long drafting sessions
